connector.name: MCP Server by aidocx
connector.registryDescription: Create, upload, and manage contracts from AI assistants. AI analysis and e-signatures.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package aidocx-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aidocx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: AIDOCX_API_KEY
env.description: API key for AiDocX (starts with ak_). Get it at https://app.aidocx.ai → Settings → API Keys

env.name: AIDOCX_API_SECRET
env.description: API secret for AiDocX (64-char hex). Get it at https://app.aidocx.ai → Settings → API Keys
